name: faultline
description: Talk to your Faultline error tracker from Claude Code — query error groups, occurrences, captured locals, and APM traces while debugging.

faultline_url.title: Faultline URL
faultline_url.description: Base URL of your Faultline mount, including the engine path. Example: http://localhost:3000/faultline (no trailing slash). The plugin appends /mcp.

faultline_token.title: MCP Bearer Token
faultline_token.description: One of the tokens you set in config.mcp_tokens in your Faultline initializer.
